faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Larkspur?
faq.answer: Larkspur homeowners typically invest $7,500 to $17,000 for a full window replacement project. This affluent Marin County community features a mix of Victorian-era homes in the historic downtown, craftsmans, and contemporary hillside properties with Bay and Mt. Tamalpais views. Single window installation starts at approximately $620.

faq.question: Do I need a permit for window replacement in Larkspur?
faq.answer: Yes. Larkspur requires a building permit for window replacements. Properties in the historic downtown corridor may be subject to design review. Our team manages all permit applications on your behalf.

faq.question: Which window brands does Deluxe Windows install in Larkspur?
faq.answer: For Larkspur's Marin County premium market, we most frequently install Milgard Ultra fiberglass for moisture resistance in the Bay-influenced climate, Andersen 400-Series for period-appropriate aesthetics in older homes, and Marvin Elevate for hillside properties with custom sizing requirements.

faq.question: Does Deluxe Windows serve all Larkspur neighborhoods?
faq.answer: Yes — we serve all of Larkspur including downtown Larkspur, Greenbrae, Kentfield, and all surrounding residential areas. Zip code: 94939.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Larkspur?
faq.answer: Most Larkspur projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once windows arrive, typically four to eight weeks after ordering.
